name: run tests
run tests.schedule tests

run tests.schedule tests.generate test plan.call test_planner
run tests.schedule tests.generate test plan.read output json
run tests.schedule tests.read build config
run tests.schedule tests.read build config.fetch master:generated/builder_configs.cfg
run tests.schedule tests.get change test history
run tests.schedule tests.get change test history.find matching builds
run tests.schedule tests.get change test history.find matching builds.buildbucket.search
run tests.schedule tests.schedule hardware tests

run tests.schedule tests.schedule hardware tests.schedule htarget.hw.bvt-inline

run tests.schedule tests.schedule tast vm tests
run tests.schedule tests.schedule moblab vm tests
run tests.collect tests

run tests.collect tests.collect skylab tasks.buildbucket.collect.get

run tests.collect tests.collect autotest vm tests.get
run tests.collect tests.collect tast vm tests
run tests.collect tests.collect tast vm tests.wait
run tests.collect tests.collect tast vm tests.get
run tests.collect tests.collect moblab vm tests

run tests.collect tests.collect moblab vm tests.get
check test results
check test results.set passed_tests
check test results.set test_failures
